definitions.explanation: Having or showing an open, friendly, and uninhibited personality.
Describing a space that feels open and unconfined.

examples.japanese: {彼女|かのじょ}は{開放的|かいほうてき}な{性格|せいかく}で{誰|だれ}とでも{仲良|なかよ}くなれる。
examples.english: She has an outgoing personality and can get along with anyone.

examples.japanese: この{会社|かいしゃ}は{開放的|かいほうてき}な{雰囲気|ふんいき}がある。
examples.english: This company has an open atmosphere.

examples.japanese: {開放的|かいほうてき}な{空間|くうかん}で{仕事|しごと}をしたい。
examples.english: I want to work in an open, spacious environment.

notes:
FORMS:
・Adverbial: {開放的|かいほうてき}に (openly)
・Noun: {開放|かいほう} (opening, liberalization)

COMMON PATTERNS:
・{開放的|かいほうてき}な{性格|せいかく} (outgoing personality)
・{開放的|かいほうてき}な{雰囲気|ふんいき} (open atmosphere)
・{開放的|かいほうてき}な{空間|くうかん} (open space)

CONTRAST:
・{開放的|かいほうてき} ↔ {閉鎖的|へいさてき} (closed, exclusive)
・For personality: {開放的|かいほうてき} (outgoing) vs {内向的|ないこうてき} (introverted)

NUANCE: When describing people, it suggests friendliness and approachability. When describing spaces or organizations, it implies transparency and accessibility.
